evidence: Caes. BG 7.8: in Arvernōs versus, the same pattern (Lewis & Short s.v. vertō)
Caes. BG 1.1.6: Belgae spectant in septentriōnēs et orientem sōlem (Lewis & Short s.v. spectō)
terms.comment: Versus here is an adverb, “turned towards”, added to in with the accusative; the north is the plural septentriōnēs, the seven stars of the Plough.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
